name: hitokoto
description: A line from Hitokoto (一言) in a band above the prompt, refreshed on a timer, per session, per prompt or once a day

refreshMode.title: Refresh mode
refreshMode.description: interval: every intervalMinutes; daily: one line a day, the same in every session; session: a new line each session; prompt: a new line each prompt

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Hitokoto category letters, comma separated (a 动画, b 漫画, c 游戏, d 文学, e 原创, f 网络, g 其他, h 影视, i 诗词, j 网易云, k 哲学, l 抖机灵); empty takes any

intervalMinutes.title: Refresh interval (min)
intervalMinutes.description: Minutes between new lines in interval mode (at least 1)
